item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-11 | 10 篇
item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. CityPlanner: A Sandbox Agent for Executable Urban Planning — CityPlanner：面向可执行城市规划的沙盒智能体 (90/100)
  2. From Pixels to Hierarchical Sequences: Quadtree Mask Encoding for Vision-Language Binary Change Detection — 从像素到层次序列：面向视觉语言二值变化检测的四叉树掩码编码 (85/100)
  3. Hyperbolic Geometry for Open-World Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery — 双曲几何用于遥感影像开放世界目标检测 (80/100)
  4. Spatio-temporal dual-stage hypergraph MARL for human-centric multimodal corridor traffic signal control — 基于时空双阶段超图多智能体强化学习的多模态走廊交通信号控制 (80/100)
  5. Physics-constrained cross-resolution enhancement network for optics-guided thermal UAV image super-resolution — 物理约束的跨分辨率增强网络用于光学引导的热红外无人机图像超分辨率 (75/100)
  6. ScopeMamba-YOLO: Widening the Perceptual Scope Inward and Outward for Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery — ScopeMamba-YOLO：面向遥感影像小目标检测的内外感知范围扩展 (75/100)
  7. Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation — Marigold V2：重新审视用于单目深度估计的扩散Transformer (75/100)
  8. Weakly-supervised Kidney Tumor Classification from CT Scans with Multi-Instance Learning and Anatomical Filtering — 基于多实例学习与解剖过滤的CT扫描肾脏肿瘤弱监督分类 (75/100)
  9. TD-STGT: A Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer for Mobile Traffic Demand Forecasting — TD-STGT：用于移动流量需求预测的时空图Transformer (75/100)
  10. DCFA: Dual-view Causal-inspired Attribution for Failure Reasoning in LLM-based Multi-agent Systems — DCFA：基于双视角因果启发的LLM多智能体系统故障推理归因 (75/100)
